newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends steadier as NYMEX heat holds gain.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends steadier as NYMEX heat holds gain.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended steadier after holding in a narrow $1 range in lacklustre trade, brokers said.
The May contract last traded 50 cents up at the day's high of $166 a tonne.
Brokers said the market steadied in late business as NYMEX heating oil prices moved moderately higher ahead of Wednesday's expiry of the May contract.
Short-covering also gave a slight boost to flagging gasoline futures but the market remained in negative territory due to ample supply, traders said.
"This morning's heating oil gains are mostly technical moves of the expiry on Wednesday," a U.S. floor trader said
At the gas oil close NYMEX May heating oil was up 0.65 cent at 56.55 cents a gallon. Gasoline was down 0.35 at 62.15 cents a gallon and June WTI crude was down five cents at $19.94 a barrel.
IPE Brent futures were two cents up at $18.29 a barrel, stuck in a narrow 12 cents trading range.
